provenance.notes: Listed as '$10 per 1,000 searches'; page states 'All prices are in USD'.

conditions: Published list price is USD 10 per 1,000 searches; converted to 10 / 1000 = USD 0.01 per single search request.
One request = one web search use, regardless of the number of results returned.
Searches that end in an error are not billed.
Token costs for search-generated content are billed separately at the selected model's token rates and are not included here.
Claude API (first-party) price; prices on other platforms were not checked.
valid_from is the capture date, not the vendor's effective date (unknown).
